name: waiver-scout
description: Waiver-wire targets before the weekly run for a Sleeper fantasy football roster: ranks free agents, names a drop for every add, and sizes the claim (FAAB bid or waiver priority) to the league's actual waiver type. Use for "who should I add/drop this week", sizing a bid, streaming K/DEF, or covering a bye week. It does not evaluate trades or track season-long news (route those elsewhere).

skills.name: Waiver targets and bid sizing
skills.description: Ranks available free agents against this roster's needs, names a drop for every add, and sizes a FAAB bid or spends waiver priority correctly for this league's waiver type.
examples: Who should I pick up this week?
How much should I bid on the new RB1 handcuff?
I need a bye-week kicker, who's available?
